rungs.description: Per-rung automation floors (docs/25). Monotonicity (higher rung => floors at least as strict) must be validated by the policy linter.

max_challenged_transaction_fraction_per_.description: docs/25 L1 client-impact budget: at most this fraction of the tenant's interactive transactions may be challenged per hour; the overflow alarms and auto-reverts to L0 (client_impact_budget_exceeded / challenge_auto_reverted_to_L0). Backed by measurement.interactive_transactions_per_hour.

nominal_rate_ceiling_per_min.description: Nominal L2 rate ceiling, requests/minute, before docs/29 rate_ceiling jitter. Required when an L2 rung floor is configured: a rate_limit action without a ceiling has no enforcement semantics (docs/25).

max_evidence_per_indicator.description: docs/23 evidence envelope: maximum evidence records considered per indicator; overflow is dropped deterministically with a reason code.

max_new_auto_actions_per_batch.description: docs/04 §8 blast-radius budget: maximum AUTO_ENFORCE/SHADOW actions one batch may propose; overflow demotes to OBSERVE with blast_radius_budget_exceeded.

interactive_transactions_per_hour.description: Operator-supplied trailing-hour interactive transaction volume — the denominator of the docs/25 L1 client-impact fraction. The offline scaffold never invents it; a set fraction with no measurement is a zero allowance (fail closed) and every challenge auto-reverts to L0. A CLI --transactions-per-hour flag overrides this when both are present.

authorized_prefixes.description: docs/04: authorized IP/CIDR target space; targets outside are hard-rejected (out_of_authorized_scope). v2.3 (audit P1-2): each entry is parsed and canonicalized at load; a malformed CIDR makes the policy un-loadable.

items.description: CIDR prefix; load-time validation is authoritative

authorized_domains.description: v2.3 (audit P1-1): explicit resolver/domain scope. A non-IP target is authorized iff it equals or is a subdomain of one of these suffixes. Empty means domain targets follow the reference default (authorized only while reference_unrestricted is true).

items.description: Domain suffix (e.g. 'example.com'); load-time validation is authoritative

reference_unrestricted.description: v2.3 (audit P1-1): explicit opt-in to unrestricted reference authorization. PROHIBITED in ENFORCE/EMERGENCY — a control plane must never authorize by default. When true (reference modes only), no boundary is required.

governed.description: v2.3 (audit P0-3): governed infrastructure registry. `dedicated_use` and `verified_rollback` are CONTROL-PLANE safety facts a feed may never assert; they are server-derived ONLY for the values listed here. Absent/empty registry = the conservative default where a feed can never self-grant a control-plane fact.

dedicated_use.description: Targets the operator certifies as dedicated-use infrastructure; only these may carry a server-derived dedicated_use fact that enables L5.

verified_rollback.description: Targets the operator certifies as rollback-verified infrastructure; only these may carry a server-derived verified_rollback fact.

no_ai_components.description: No-AI invariant flag (docs/28): platform must operate with zero AI/ML/LLM components.

max_behavioral_m_contribution.description: Cap on combined behavioral contribution to M; keeps behavioral evidence below deny floors on its own.

randomization.description: Seeded randomization bounds (docs/29). Bounds are policy; draws are recorded per decision.

epoch.description: P1-8 (audit): explicit randomization epoch. If set (non-'0'), used verbatim; a schema-valid policy can therefore pin the moving-target rotation. Mutually independent of rotation_interval_seconds.

rotation_interval_seconds.description: P1-8 (audit): versioned rotation interval (seconds) over the policy clock (reference_now when pinned, wall clock otherwise). When > 0, the effective epoch is DERIVED as floor(clock_seconds / interval), so moving-target rotation advances with time without a per-epoch redeploy.

mechanisms.description: Only mechanisms the engine actually wires may be declared. A declared-but-unimplemented mechanism (challenge_sampling, shadow_review_sampling, threshold_dither) would be a silently inert knob (audit P1-7..11) and is rejected by validation; it is therefore not a legal schema member.

reference_now.description: Replay clock (docs/10): pins evidence-recency evaluation to this instant so decision byte-replay is exact. Absent = live wall clock.
